title: Sprints 6e to 6i: a rented server set up from the secrets file, its files uploaded, no drive, its forge's certificate, the homeserver published

steps.say:
0-1. What this walk needs, all on the laptop in your own account. It rents one server at Scaleway for about 40 minutes and gives it back at the end.

- keepassxc-cli: sudo apt install keepassxc-minimal (once, in a terminal of your own).
- Your Scaleway key, set in Forges; your secrets file ~/Porelo/secrets.kdbx with its master password (walk 18).
- The project sprint5 on this computer, with its earlier server setup remembered: Scaleway project 5075079b-230c-41ea-8e71-1627ff0c8f08, account porelo, signing key /home/michi/.porelo/handover/porelo-host-scaleway-test/wg/signer.pub, ssh key ~/.ssh/porelo-host.
- porelo-host's guides for 6e to 6i beside you: ~/.porelo/handover/porelo-project/sprint6e … sprint6i/steps-porelo-host.md.

Start it from ~/git/porelo-frontend (it builds porelo-host from this checkout and fetches the collection 0.5.7, checked against its digest; the interface is started as its own program, not through flutter run, since the flutter snap's confinement keeps wg-quick from bringing the VPN up):

mkdir -p ~/.porelo/walk && cp doc/walks/19-sprints-6e-to-6i-a-rented-server.json ~/.porelo/walk/walk.json && (cd packages/porelo_host && dart compile exe bin/porelo_host.dart -o ~/.porelo/walk/porelo-host) && tool/fetch_collection.sh 0.5.7 8ef7122ccb0f9ae34dee22c0ccf1e59b98734a4a1eb7eabaa7dd145992b72f9b ~/.porelo/walk && flutter build linux --debug && PORELO_HOST_STANDIN=$HOME/.porelo/walk/porelo-host PORELO_WALK=$HOME/.porelo/walk build/linux/x64/debug/bundle/porelo_frontend

Steps 6e-1 to 6e-7 were walked before you, up to Put it on a server; nothing after it could be, since nothing was rented before you. This panel moves on by itself when it sees what a step waits for; where you are ahead of it, click Next in this panel. Once all of this is in place, click Next here.

6e-1. In the rail click Projects, click sprint5, then the menu button beside its title (What sprint5 can be told to do) and Put this project on a server…. Expected: the wizard Put the project sprint5 on a server opens at step 1 of 7, Where it is rented.

6e-2. Step 1, Where it is rented: Scaleway project id 5075079b-230c-41ea-8e71-1627ff0c8f08 and Account on the server porelo, both filled from your last setup. Click Next. Step 2, The project: it says A drive folder from an earlier setup, /home/michi/Tresorit/PORELO_HOST, is read once more: a server key it still holds moves into your secrets file; leave it, do not click Forget it. Public key for signing commits /home/michi/.porelo/handover/porelo-host-scaleway-test/wg/signer.pub, filled; no vault entry files for sprint5. Expected: no Tresorit folder and no tresor name are asked (6g). Click Next.

6e-3. Step 3, Your ssh keys: Your private ssh key ~/.ssh/porelo-host; Your public ssh key fills itself with ~/.ssh/porelo-host.pub, with a check mark. Click Next. Expected: step 4 of 7, Your secrets file, its field ~/Porelo/secrets.kdbx, It is there, and the button Open it now.

6e-4. Click Open it now. In the terminal that opens inside this program, type your master password and press Enter. Expected: nothing you type is shown, then The secrets file is ready; click Done below the terminal. Expected: the step says Ready: the file keeps the server's keys.
6e-5. Click Next. Expected: step 5, A test collection.

6e-6. Step 5, A test collection (only in a development build like this one): Test collection ~/.porelo/walk/porelo-host-0.5.7.tar.gz, Test collection SHA-256 8ef7122ccb0f9ae34dee22c0ccf1e59b98734a4a1eb7eabaa7dd145992b72f9b (v0.5.7's own SHA256SUMS).

6e-7. Click Next. Read every answer on Check and start, then click Put it on a server: from here on a server is rented. Expected: the wizard closes. In the rail click Machines: your project's server is listed In preparation.

6f-1. Click the In preparation row to open its protocol. Expected: before up, the machine file and the project bundle are uploaded over the server's own ssh (the summary named /etc/porelo-host/setup/<project>.bundle); nothing is read from a drive. On the server, porelo-host's 6f guide checks the files' owner and mode.

6e-8. When the setup stops, open Needs you and Complete setup on the host. Expected: it names what the host needs (its new vault's passphrase, its VPN key, the files of its vault entries, and its forge's certificate) and says They come from your secrets file: type its master password once, in the terminal on this computer. No Tresorit login is asked (6g).

6e-9. Click Open the terminal and type your master password once. Expected: nothing you type is shown; then The host has what it needs; setup goes on. Click Done. Failure signs: has no entry … nothing was sent names an entry missing from your file; a message beginning porelo-host-stop: with 64 is a line the host refused (porelo-host's 6e guide).

6h-1. The stop above also said The host's forge needs its certificate: signed on this computer by your lasting CA. Expected in the same terminal: the CA is made once in your secrets file (shared/forge-ca-key, shared/forge-ca), and the certificate goes to the host; no file of the CA is left on this computer.

6e-10. The setup goes on by itself to its VPN step, and a terminal on this computer asks your sudo password for the VPN. Type it there. Expected: the VPN check pings the server and waits for a fresh handshake; then the terminal closes and the server shows as a machine in Machines.

6i-1. Only where this account runs its own homeserver (porelo-message-matrix's 6i guide, steps M1 and M2): right after the VPN, Your homeserver for this server says Your homeserver is published for this server's tasks at https://matrix.porelo.internal:<port>, on 10.73.0.2. Where /etc/hosts lacks it, the line 127.0.0.1 matrix.porelo.internal # porelo-matrix is shown with a copy button: add it once, by hand, in a separate terminal with sudo. Click Close. This replaces Matrix's own publish step; go on there with the host's side and its matrix-token (porelo-host's 6i guide).

6h-2. In Firefox, open https://forge.porelo.internal/ . Expected: no certificate warning, and no CA imported or hosts line written by hand; the VPN step put the CA into the system store and Firefox's policy and the name into /etc/hosts. Signing in with the lasting password is not in this sprint. Then click Next in this panel.

6e-11. In the rail click Machines and your server's row. Expected: it is ready, reached over the VPN. Work through porelo-host's guides for 6e to 6i (~/.porelo/handover/porelo-project/sprint6e … sprint6i/steps-porelo-host.md); their commands need no values: they read the server rented now from this interface's settings. Then come back here and click Next in this panel.

End-1. In Machines, open the menu of the row sprint5 server (⋮ at its right) and Take this server down, then confirm. Expected: the server's give-back is confirmed and it leaves Machines. With 6i, a failure to close your homeserver's published address is said in this dialog; in Claude, ! grep -c PORELO_MATRIX_PUBLISH ~/.config/porelo/matrix/homeserver.conf prints 0. Then tell me what differed.
